component.name: DroidPlay
component.summary: Build the Switch games you own into Android apps

description.p: DroidPlay builds your own copy of a Switch game into an Android app: the game's code runs directly on the phone's processor, not in an emulator, and its graphics are drawn by the phone's GPU through Vulkan. You build each game once on this computer, and DroidPlay installs it on your phone over adb.
Bring your own game: you dump the game and the keys from your own Switch. Nothing from any game comes with DroidPlay.
